text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Diamond Stakes. Being 
called out to by fans in front of the 
racetrack—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A round-glassed reporter she had met on 
campus once praised her for pursuing 
victory with a positive attitude, saying, 
"Your words saved me, Tannhauser-san."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Bolstered by the support of many, the 
challenge for the Diamond Stakes was set!
